# MOOC.fi

> > MOOC.fi offers free, university-credited online courses in programming, web development, AI, and cybersecurity from the University of Helsinki.

MOOC.fi is Finland's leading platform for massive open online courses (MOOCs), providing high-quality education in computer science and related fields. The platform combines interactive learning with assessments through Test My Code and partners with industry leaders like F-Secure to deliver practical, real-world skills.

## Key Topics

- MOOC (Massive Open Online Course)
- University of Helsinki

## Getting Started

- [MOOC.fi](https://moocfi.github.io): MOOC.fi homepage showcasing online courses in programming, AI, and web development
- [Mikä mooc?](https://moocfi.github.io/mooc.html): Introduction to MOOC concept and platform explaining free online learning model
- [English courses](https://moocfi.github.io/english.html): Catalog of English-language courses including Java, AI, and cybersecurity offerings

## Featured Courses

- [Full Stack Open 2018](https://moocfi.github.io/courses/2018/fullstack): Full Stack Open course covering React, Node.js, and MongoDB web development
- [Ohjelmoinnin MOOC – 2018](https://moocfi.github.io/courses/2018/ohjelmoinnin-mooc): Finnish programming fundamentals course from University of Helsinki with university credit
- [Cyber Security Base with F-Secure](https://moocfi.github.io/courses/2017/cybersecurity): Cybersecurity course with F-Secure covering vulnerabilities, cryptography, and secure development

## For Educators

- [MOOC.fi opettajille](https://moocfi.github.io/opettajille.html): Guide for teachers on using MOOC.fi platform with Test My Code assessment tools

## Legal & Privacy

- [On cookies and privacy](https://moocfi.github.io/cookies): Privacy policy explaining cookie usage and browser data collection practices
- [Evästeistä ja yksityisyydestä](https://moocfi.github.io/evasteet): Finnish version of privacy and cookie policy for user data management
